scenes.title: AROUND THE MOON
vo: Four astronauts flew around the Moon this year, and gravity drove them home.
One of them, Christina Koch, was just named NASA's acting deputy chief engineer.

scenes.title: LEVEL 1
vo: Their Orion capsule fired its engine one last big time, aimed at the Moon.

scenes.title: LEVEL 2
vo: Picture space as a stretchy sheet.
Earth and the Moon press dips into it, and Orion rolls toward the Moon like a marble.

scenes.title: LEVEL 3
vo: It swings around the far side, and the Moon's pull bends its path back toward Earth.
No big burn needed. That's a free-return trajectory.

scenes.title: LEVEL 4
vo: At their farthest, they were two hundred fifty-two thousand miles from Earth.
That beat Apollo thirteen's record from nineteen seventy.

scenes.title: BONUS
vo: Behind the Moon, they lost contact with Earth for about forty minutes.
